# Changes

## Next (ETS Dev 3.4 / Release 1.0, version numbers are placeholders)

**Migration**

* The hardware selection moved to the new page OpenKNX → „Gerät" (directly after „Allgemein", module generated by OGM-HardwareConfig). After "Aktualisieren" it shows „Nicht gewählt" once (tree: „Gerät (nicht gewählt)"): select the device type there or use „Vom Gerät lesen". Until then the device drives no strip and no relay, also no „Manuell" GPIO. The port selections of the strips and relays are kept (same parameter IDs), except relay 1 of the boards with an onboard relay (QuinLED Dig2Go, Gledopto GL-C-017WL and GL-C-620WL): its port parameter is gone (relay hard-wired), and a strip stored on the onboard relay port is reset by the update (select its port again)
* Unreleased Dev 2.1 test builds had hardware page switches „Netzwerk-Modul" / „WLAN" (default on); they are gone. The network of a TP firmware now follows the OpenKNX module checkbox „Netzwerk" (off on boards without network); a device programmed with such a test build gets the update to Dev 3.4 („Aktualisieren"; Dev 3.4 replaces versions down to 0.14): check that checkbox afterwards
* Effect parameters reset once: after „Aktualisieren" to Dev 2.3 or later the effect-specific parameters of every LED segment and of every effect-manager cue stand at their defaults (new parameter IDs); set them again. The effect selection, the scenes and all other parameters keep their values
* Laufschrift is a 2D effect (its header reports `DIM_2D` only): on hardware built without the 2D effects (`NEOPIXEL_DISABLE_2D`: KNeoPix/Mini ESP32C6) a segment, scene or cue with Laufschrift stands at „Solid" after „Aktualisieren" to Dev 2.12 (ETS resets a value its list no longer has; measured in ETS6 for a scene), and its firmware leaves the effect out
* Segment overview on hardware without the 2D effects (KNeoPix/Mini ESP32C6): before Dev 2.12 its column „Effekt" set another parameter (full list) than the segment page (reduced list) of the same byte; from Dev 2.12 both show the value of the segment page. After „Aktualisieren" check the effect of every segment on such a device
* Fire (Dev 3.0): the flame pace follows its „Geschwindigkeit" (128 = one step every 50 ms) instead of the frame rate; with „Aktualisierungsrate" Normal (20 FPS) nothing changes, with Slow (10 FPS) a fire at the default speed runs twice as fast as before, with Fast, Max or Extreme slower
* Fire (Dev 3.0): its „Richtung umkehren" now reverses the flames; before the setting had no effect, so a project with it switched on burns the other way after the update
* The detection button of an older application (function property 158/10) gets „not supported" from this firmware; the button of the page OpenKNX → „Gerät" uses 158/4
* Netzwerk (Dev 3.2): earlier Dev versions wrote the checkbox „Netzwerk" itself (on for a device with the network module and for „nicht gewählt", off otherwise); Dev 3.2 only sets it off on devices without the network module, everywhere else it has its own value. A project that had a device without the network module selected keeps that stored off after „Aktualisieren", also when a device with the network module is selected later: check the checkbox under OpenKNX → „Module"

**Product**
* Change (Dev 3.4): page OpenKNX → „Gerät" no longer lists the functions of the selected device under the device card (shown in Dev 3.2 and 3.3); the Dev product keeps the same rows in its developer view („Module und Funktionen")
* Change (Dev 3.3): device card on page OpenKNX → „Gerät": name as headline, below it the logo of the device left (vendor logo from `HW_INFO_LOGO` of the board header, else the OpenKNX logo) with the badge „Drittanbieter / Hardware" under it on third-party devices, every logo on one line with and without QR code, the board text in two parts (`HW_INFO_TEXT`, `HW_INFO_TEXT2`) in the middle and the QR code with „Geräteinfo" under it on the right instead of the link (OGM-HardwareConfig); notice under third-party devices: „Hardware eines Drittanbieters. OpenKNX ist ein Open-Source-Projekt ohne geschäftliche Verbindung zum Hersteller und liefert nur die Firmware. …"
* Change (Dev 3.2): the notices „Effekt nicht verfügbar" / „Hinweis: Dieser Effekt fehlt in einer Firmware-Variante" under the effect selection of segments, scenes and cues come from OGM-HardwareConfig `<ValueNotices>` (XML per board, no script): the calculation NEO_EffectAvailability and its 21 flags without memory per segment and effect manager are gone; texts and conditions unchanged
* Change (Dev 3.2): the OpenKNX module checkbox „Netzwerk" is set off on devices without the network module (OGM-HardwareConfig `<Fix capability="!Network">`) instead of the calculation NEO_SetNetworkModuleVisibility; on devices with it the device selection no longer switches it on, it keeps its own value (default on)
* Change (Dev 3.0): page OpenKNX → „Info LEDs" shows the rows „Info 1"–„Info 3" only for the LEDs the selected device has, named from the board header (OpenKNXiao RP2040: „Info 1 (grün)", „Info 2 (blau)"); with no device selected all three rows as before (OGM-HardwareConfig `<PartRows>` on the OGM-Common page, product token `%BASE_InfoLedPart%`)
* Change (Dev 3.1): the effect lists of segments, scenes, effect manager cues and the segment overview on hardware without the 2D effects come from OGM-HardwareConfig `<Filters>` (src/NeoPixel.Effects2D.values from Build-EffectParameters.ps1): the reduced list has no memory and copies its value into the effect selector, so the effect settings, the availability check and the firmware read one parameter; the second selector on the same byte, its three types and the doubled effect settings are gone (same entries in ETS)
* Change (Dev 3.0): relay page: „Externe Relais" offers 0..the relay count of the selected device instead of 0..4, the error „Mehr Relais eingestellt, als diese Hardware bietet" is gone, the two supply hints are one line (OGM-HardwareConfig `<Filters>` on the carrier `NEOExternalRelayCount`, firmware unchanged)
* Fix (Dev 3.0): Fire ignored „Geschwindigkeit" (one simulation step per frame) and „Richtung umkehren" (the effect read another field)
* Change (Dev 3.0): /neo and Studio list the effects with the German names in the order of the ETS effect list (1D, then „1D/2D ·", then „2D ·") and show the effect parameters with their ETS labels; Studio offers 2D-only effects on 2D segments only (the state API reports `is2D` per segment), both pages keep the running effect selectable, and Studio reports a stored effect this firmware lacks as Solid, as the device runs it
* Fix (Dev 2.12): on hardware without the 2D effects the effect settings of a segment, a scene and an effect-manager cue follow the effect list shown there (the reduced one); before, they followed the hidden full list and showed the settings of another effect or none; a scene sets the defaults of its new effect there too (second calculation on the reduced list)
* Fix (Dev 2.12): on hardware without the 2D effects the column „Effekt" of the segment overview (page „Segmente") offers the reduced list as the segment page; before, it offered all 33 effects, and a 2D effect chosen there ran as „Solid"
* Change (Dev 2.12): the effect lists are sorted 1D, 1D/2D, 2D, with the prefix „1D/2D ·" or „2D ·" from `getCapabilities()` of the effect header; „2D" left the names in the lists (the setting rows keep e.g. „Uhr 2D"), the effect numbers stay
* Change (Dev 2.12): the effect settings have German labels (`getParameterLabel()` with `PARAM_LABEL_DE_EN` in the effect headers of OFM-NeoPixel) instead of the parameter identifiers („Speed", „FadeRate")
* Fix (Dev 2.12): the ETS context help of the effect selection (segment, scene, cue) lists all effects grouped 1D, 1D/2D, 2D with number and description; the help of an effect setting has the German label as title and lists its choices with their number; before, ETS showed the block marker of the generated table as text and the table as broken lines
* Change (Dev 2.9): on hardware with WiFi, Netzwerk → „WiFi-Schnittstelle" is „Ja" and read-only (HardwareManifest.xml <Fixes>); Dev 2.7 only preset it, Dev 2.8 showed the read-only row with its own value
* Change (Dev 2.7): on hardware with WiFi, Netzwerk → „WiFi-Schnittstelle" is set to „Ja" (the WiFi page is there); the device query messages say „Gerät"; the developer view lists module, boards and the bit order of the device query while no device type is selected
* Change (Dev 2.6): the hardware page is now „Gerät" (OGM-HardwareConfig device page): headline „Gerät auswählen", selection „Gerätetyp", button „Vom Gerät lesen" with a help box and a steps picture for a greyed-out button; the tree shows „Gerät (nicht gewählt)" until a device type is selected
* Change (Dev 2.5): the hardware page shows a board text for the OpenKNX UP1 UART Gateway (`HW_INFO_TEXT` of the board header in OGM-HardwareConfig) instead of the default text
* Feature: ETS checks the effect of the segment, of each scene and of each effect-manager cue against the firmware of the selected hardware (`HardwareManifest.xml <BoardTable>` over `NEO_FXOFF_<n>` with the build flags of every env): „Effekt nicht verfügbar" (error) when every firmware variant of the board leaves the effect out (the device runs „Solid"), „Hinweis" when only some do; no message without a selected or with an unknown board. Flags without device memory, one calculation per segment and per effect manager
* Feature: effect groups of the product in `src/NeoPixel.EffectGroups.xml` (`-D NEOPIXEL_DISABLE_GROUP_<NAME>` leaves out every member) and the generated `src/NeoPixelEffectGroups.h`, force-included into every unit (`platformio.custom.ini`); it also defines `NEO_FXOFF_<n>` (1 = effect n left out, same conditions as the effect pool). A `NEOPIXEL_MINIMAL_EFFECTS` build links now (the generated effect type mapping guards the extended effects with that flag too)
* Change: effect parameter IDs depend only on the effect number and the parameter index (segment `21` + channel + effect 2 digits + index 2 digits, cue `22` + channel + cue digit + effect 2 digits + index 1 digit; both prefixes are unused in Dev 2.2, so the update carries no old value into another parameter): a new effect or a parameter appended to an effect no longer moves another ID, room for effects 1..99 (segment: 100 parameters each, cue: 10). The generator stops on an effect number above 99, a segment index above 99, a cue index above 9 or a duplicate ID
* Feature: page OpenKNX → „Gerät" with an intro text and the hardware selection. With nothing selected: section „Oder automatisch erkennen" with the device query (HW-ID and capabilities), a help box and a steps picture for a greyed-out button; the query button is shown only in this state. With a board selected: device card from ETS elements: OpenKNX logo or, for third-party boards, the badge „Drittanbieter / Hardware", the board name as headline, the board text (`HW_INFO_TEXT` of the board header, else „Die Einstellungen dieser Applikation sind auf diese Hardware abgestimmt."), with an info link of the board the QR code and the link right of the text; third-party boards add one notice box. Context help (F1) of the page: NEO-Hardware. The Dev application also shows a developer view (checkbox „Entwickleransicht", default off: Board, Module und Funktionen, Ports table, hard-wired relays)
* Change: the ETS port conflict check is the one of the hardware generator (`HardwareManifest.xml <Conflicts>`): every active signal (data and clock of strips 1..„Anzahl der LED-Streifen", relays 1..„Externe Relais", hard-wired relays always) resolves to a GPIO of the selected hardware (port, „Manuell" or `HW_RELAY_<n>_GPIO`); two signals on one GPIO show „GPIO-Konflikt" at each of them, the strip page separately for data and clock. It reads the port parameter of the selected board: no false conflicts from the ports of an earlier hardware any more, no check while no hardware is selected. SPI LED types (5 6 21 22 23 24 25) count with MOSI and clock
* Fix: LPD6803 and P9813 run on the SPI driver with MOSI and clock, as the driver library classifies them (`ProtocolHelper::isSPI`); before, the firmware treated them as 1-Wire types and passed no clock GPIO to the SPI driver. RP2040/RP2350 only: the ESP32 SPI driver of OFM-NeoPixel has no LPD6803/P9813 packing yet (the strip stays dark there)
* Change: the ETS conflict check also flags a strip or relay signal on a GPIO the selected board uses itself („GPIO reserviert"): the pins OGM-Common drives (Prog button/LED, info LEDs, serial LED, function buttons, save interrupt), the KNX UART of a TP firmware, the ESP32 flash / PSRAM bus and the NeoPixel list in `HardwareManifest.xml <ReservedPins>` (NEOPIX LED, serial LED power, Ethernet PHY of the QuinLED Ethernet boards and the Gledopto GL-C-620WL). The firmware refuses the same pins with the generated `HardwareProfile::isReservedGpio` (replaces the own check in NeoPixelModule). KNeoPiX S3 V1/V1.5 (TP and IP firmware under one hardware) show a hint at the KNX UART pins 43/44
* Change: an IP-only firmware (KNeoPiX S3 _IP, Gledopto, QuinLED) no longer refuses the KNX UART pins of its board header (Gledopto GPIO 3 and 36, KNeoPiX S3 _IP GPIO 43 and 44); a TP firmware still does
* Change: the conflict flags have no device memory; the former flags (bytes 88, 89, 103) and the copies of the strip ports (bytes 80..87, 90..97) with their copy calculations are gone, every other parameter keeps its ID and offset
* Change: the firmware resolves strip and relay ports with `HardwareProfile::signalGpio` / `relaySignalGpio` (generated, same port values 10 = manual, 15 = none as the ETS check)
* Change: while the ETS hardware selection is not the board of the firmware, no port byte is used (before, „Manuell" still drove its GPIO)
* Change: the WiFi settings (Netzwerk → „WiFi-Schnittstelle“ and the WiFi page) are offered only on hardware whose firmware has WiFi (capability „WLAN“ of the hardware module: KNeoPiX S3 V1/V1.5, Gledopto 309WL/017WL, QuinLED Dig2Go, Uno/Quad V3 WiFi and AE+, Uno/Quad V4 WiFi, Octa WiFi (V1, V2, V4), Next2) and while no hardware is selected
* Change: onboard relays are hard-wired (board header `HW_RELAY_*`): QuinLED Dig2Go IO12, Gledopto GL-C-017WL IO18, GL-C-620WL IO18. Relay 1 has no port selection, the relay page shows the connection, the relay pin is no LED port any more (a strip stored on it, or the same GPIO as „Manuell", is switched off and flagged in ETS); further relays keep the port selection (017WL: relay 2). QuinLED Uno, Quad, Octa, Next2 and Gledopto 309WL keep the relay port selection as in 2.0
* Change: a TP firmware with the network module (KNeoPix S3 _TPWIFI) starts it only while the OpenKNX module checkbox „Netzwerk" is on (unprogrammed device: on; logged when off); an IP firmware never reads it. A firmware without the network module reports Netzwerk and WLAN as unsupported, a LAN-only firmware WLAN, so „Nicht unterstützte Module deaktivieren" / „Komplettabgleich aller Module" (now shown on OpenKNX → „Module") switch the checkbox off
* Change: the device query no longer reports a build difference for capabilities in which the firmware variants of one board differ (KNeoPiX S3 V1/V1.5: TP, IP, TP+WLAN)
* Change: the device query answers one more capability bit: „KNX über IP" (bit 4, mask 0x57B0)
* Change: the network module („Netzwerk") is offered only on hardware whose firmware has it (`KNX_IP_LAN`/`KNX_IP_WIFI`): the 21 third-party boards and KNeoPiX S3 V1/V1.5; the module checkbox follows the hardware selection and stays on while no hardware is selected. KNeoPiX C3/C5/C6 (V1, V1.5) lose the Netzwerk channel; their firmware never had a network module, stored network settings stay in the project
* Change: the firmware reads each strip/relay port through one carrier parameter and `hwPortGpio()` (OGM-HardwareConfig `HardwareConfig/Helpers/HardwarePorts.h`); the per-board switch and `HardwareMappingData.h` are gone
* Change: the OpenKNXiao Mini boards (RP2040, RP2350, ESP32-S3/C3/C5/C6) offer all 8 ports D1-D5, D8-D10 like KNeoPiX (before D1-D3); the firmware also initialises the 5 added pins (output low) at start
* Feature: QuinLED Dig-Uno V4, Dig-Quad V4 (WiFi, Ethernet) and Dig-Octa 32-8L V2, V4 (WiFi, Ethernet) in the hardware selection (board numbers 32-39); their relay output is a normal port, one relay offered as on the V3 boards
* Change: the hardware page shows the info link of the board as a QR code with the link in one line below (KNeoPiX: go.openknx.de/kneopix, UP1 UART Gateway: go.openknx.de/up1-gw-uart); boards without an info link show no QR code
* Limit: NeoPixel stores hardware ports 1..10 per board (value 10 = manual GPIO); a board with more ports stops the build


## ALPHA-DEV-v2.0.0: 2026-10-31 (not released, see doc/TODO.md Prio 0 and 1)

ETS product **2.0** (`NeoPixel-Dev`), release variant **0.15** (`NeoPixel-Release`). Alpha dev build for testers,
not a public release: the Prio 0 and Prio 1 items of `doc/TODO.md` are still open; it carries everything since the tag `v0.3`
(2026-06-21). The parameter layout, the object numbers and the flash layout changed on the way, so a device needs
this knxprod and a full ETS download after the firmware update.

**Migration — read before updating**

What a device needs depends on the version it comes from.

* Dev applications before 0.14 cannot be updated (`ReplacesVersionsDownTo="0.14"`): ETS only offers "Applikationsprogramm ändern", which resets every parameter and drops every link, so configure these devices again. Release updates from 0.1. Since Dev 2.3 (`faccd02`) every effect parameter has a new ID, so "Aktualisieren" resets the effect parameters to their defaults whatever ID scheme the old version used (Release 0.1–0.8, a Dev 0.14 build of 2026-09-02 before `2e7361c`); see the migration notes of the next version
* Update the device in ETS with "Aktualisieren", not "Applikationsprogramm ändern": only the update takes the parameter values over
* From an application before Dev 1.1 / Release 0.11, LightManager 0.4: after the ETS update every light manager is deactivated; activate it again under "Kanalauswahl", its settings are kept
* Set the port selection of the LED strips and relays again: the port parameters of each hardware are numbered by its position in the hardware list, and that list changed (KNeoPiX V1.5 added, REG2 and the PiPico BCU Connectors removed, the product now lists every hardware)
* Effektkette, firmware from before 2026-10-20: update all devices of a chain together. A master with older firmware always reports OFF and a slave with new firmware then switches off; a slave with older firmware restarts its effect on every telegram of the master
* The current objects changed from DPT 7.600 to 7.012 (mA) with Dev 1.2 / Release 0.12: check the group addresses linked to them
* From an application before 0.5 (Release 0.3/0.4): object numbers moved. A segment has 53 objects instead of 40 (segment n moves by 13 × (n−1)), the LightManager objects moved by +210 (single objects, 1252 → 1462) and +240 (channels, 1260 → 1500), and the Effektmanager control objects (Start/Stop/Status/CueSet/EffektText/SyncChain) are segment objects K42–K52. ETS moves group addresses by object number, so check these links. Timing values 9 and 10 (old 960 duplicate / 1000 kHz) map to 750/765 kHz; check the timing
* RP2040/RP2350 release firmware (KNeoPiX V1/V1.5, OpenKNXiao Mini, UP1) from before 2026-08-25: the KNX region moved to `0x0E0000` and the filesystem grew. After the firmware update the device needs an ETS download; "Letzter Zustand" and the filesystem content are gone. The debug envs keep the old regions, so switching between a debug and a release image moves them as well
* ESP32: what moves depends on the firmware the device runs; the boundary is the build of 2026-09-03 19:11 (commit `420ad99`). OTA never rewrites the partition table, so where something moves, flash over USB with the factory image, then download with ETS
  * every ESP32 before 2026-08-25, and the 8 MB targets (ESP32-S3, -C5) up to `420ad99`: `knx` moves to `0x290000` and grows from 64 to 100 KB; `nvs` stays at `0x2C0000`, the WiFi credentials are kept
  * 4 MB targets (OpenKNXiao C3/C6, KNeoPiX C3/C6, Gledopto, QuinLED) from 2026-08-25 up to `420ad99`: `knx` is already at `0x290000`, but `openknx`, `nvs` and the filesystem move, so the WiFi credentials, the saved state and the filesystem content are gone
  * firmware from `420ad99` on already has this layout and needs no USB flash

**Product**
* Feature: timing rework with chip profiles; the ETS bit rate 0 uses the chip profile, every other value scales it
* Feature: brightness cascade global × segment × effect; lock object, Effektmanager stop mode, cue +/-, Effektmanager pause/resume and state objects
* Feature: per-strip signal polarity, white calculation and refresh in the off state; WRGB and a chip-default option for the colour order
* Feature: file transfer over KNX on every architecture; printf from ROM on ESP32-C3, -S3 and -C5
* Feature: segment and global power model — Effektmanager pauses on OFF, lock priority, switch-on by brightness and scene; status objects computed from the live state and optionally sent once after a restart
* Feature: DPT 3.007 start/stop dimming of the relative objects
* Feature: Effektkette with power, heartbeat (3 s), override policy and bounds; the status page shows the last sync payload of a slave and colours the sync link by its state
* Feature: boot and segment-power autostart of the Effektmanager are separate
* Feature: per-relay behaviour before upload/restart (unchanged / off) and after restart (off / on / last state)
* Feature: the 2D effects are hidden in ETS where the device cannot render them; C6 targets build without them
* Feature: WiFi module in the network channel of the ETS product; WiFi envs with setup access point, gateway ping and QR code
* Feature: KNeoPiX V1.5 (SN74LV8T245 level shifter) and KNeoPiX V1.4/V1.5 ESP32-S3 builds with KNX over TP and WiFi
* Feature: NeoPixel status page `/neo` (hardware, setup with top view and LED image, control, segments, Effektmanager, Effektkette, strips/power/relays) as the default page, and the NeoPixel Studio with live and draft mode, LED test and ETS synchronisation; both share `np-base.css`, the Studio gets state changes over the UI socket
* Feature: example configurations for ConfigTransfer and an offline configurator (`doc/examples`), made for Dev 1.2 / Release 0.12; the import into 2.0 / 0.15 is not checked
* Change: the ETS pages follow the setup workflow: Allgemein → Relais → Physikalisch → Virtuell/Segmente → Effektmanager
* Change: REG2 and the PiPico BCU Connectors are no longer built, they have no level shifter
* Change: the ETS product offers every hardware in every build (`HardwareListMode 'Full'`); the generator stops on a single hardware and on a duplicate `DEVICE_HW_ID`
* Change: OFM-UsbExchange is no longer part of the product; it was compiled out in every env
* Fix: the saved segment state (power, brightness, colour, effect, scene) is applied after a restart and kept across an ETS download, only for segments set to "Letzter Zustand"; relays follow their own after-restart parameter; after a power cut the last saved state comes back, see `doc/TODO.md`
* Fix: one colour and one white value for the direct colour objects, RGBW, RGBCCT, start colour and sync; WS2805 CCT drives its white channels; the H/S/V objects follow the HSV object
* Fix: port selections have their own bytes and are decoded by value; the relay port comes from the parameter of the selected hardware; a GPIO already driven by a relay or another strip, a board button, a status LED, the ESP32 flash bus or the Ethernet PHY is refused
* Fix: relays — an inverted relay is off at boot, an ON within the minimum off-time is deferred instead of dropped
* Fix: scenes — numbers not configured on the segment are ignored, learned scenes keep their effect text and survive an unchanged ETS download
* Fix: power objects are sent within the status budget and declared as DPST-14-56, the strip load of the fallback path is clamped to 100 %, strips with their own limit are measured while global limiting is off
* Fix: Effektmanager — stop only on value 1, the cue effect is entered again when a segment is switched on, the started-from-OFF origin survives a restart
* Fix: an Effektkette master sits at band offset 0
* Fix: HCL is applied only from an active LightManager channel and mapped over the physical length of a segment
* Fix: power limiting uses the ETS current per LED (RGBW read 33 % high before) and the ETS voltage; the ABL warning is raised and cleared with the limiter
* Fix: a strip behind a disabled strip attaches at its ETS position; the ETS keeps the WRGB/chip-default colour order of a TM1814 when the LED type changes instead of falling back to GRB
* Fix: a lock stops a running dim ramp; unknown or disabled effect IDs are rejected; the segment offset rotates only inside Start..End
* Fix: shutdown blanks the LEDs without stalling the download; telegrams of the startup delay are processed after the flash restore

**Build and test**
* `Build-Release.ps1` takes the options of the IP-Interface build: `-Rel`/`-Dev`, `-SkipOknx` (`-SkipTool`, `-SkipHostCli`), `-SkipKnxprod`; `-SkipFirmware -SkipOknx` leaves `NeoPixel-Dev.knxprod` (with `-Rel` `NeoPixel-Release.knxprod`) in the repository root, `-Clean` removes all producer outputs
* The generators sort and write the same output under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7
* `test/ets/Invoke-NeoPixelEtsTest.ps1`: data-driven device test against an ETS configuration (bus, console, web page, LED image)
